tasks.short: Advise architecture students on curricula and careers.

steps.what: Understand the architecture student's actual academic interests, progress and career questions
Locate and verify current architecture curricula, prerequisites and relevant career information
inputs: actual current course and career sources
outputs: verified applicable curriculum and career sources

steps.what: Advise on actual curriculum choices, studio pathways and career tradeoffs
inputs: verified applicable curriculum and career sources
outputs: actual academic and vocational advice and student response

steps.what: Write and check actual assigned advising notes and retain the internal record
inputs: actual academic and vocational advice and student response

tasks.design: Configure current architecture curriculum and prerequisite links in {LMS}/{DOCS}. Remove repeated source navigation while retaining actual student understanding, tailored advice and full assigned written notes; internal saving stays unchanged and ungated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current course and prerequisite versions can require repeated lookup.
tasks.enabler_now: Native current-source links can remove navigation without choosing a student's path.
tasks.still_hard: Career uncertainty and individual studio development require personal judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher helps a student reconcile portfolio interests with actual study constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less curriculum navigation; advising responsibility stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current curriculum links can reduce source navigation without replacing student advising.

assumptions: Provisional source15 includes three repeated version/path locating points removed; reading and applicability checks remain. Assigned notes are separated from advising and fully retained; remove/reweight if another role owns them. No transcript or student decision is inferred.

Programme owners supply actual course id, year/version, prerequisites and current status; students supply their actual interests and progress. Missing or conflicting rules require manual owner confirmation. Existing native links earn no new saving. This is internal/live advice, without an invented separate send.
unknowns: Are current prerequisite sources already linked?
research_questions: Can source links distinguish current architecture studio requirements from prior-year rules?

incremental.description: Maintain current architecture curriculum and career-source links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes3 source-navigation points minus0.3 upkeep=2.7. Low: a student explores an unfamiliar career requiring new manual sources; only1 current-curriculum locating point is removed, minus0.3=0.7. Student understanding, advice and written notes retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct architecture research and publish findings.

steps.what: Choose and conduct actual architectural research and verify findings and limitations
inputs: actual field, design or archival evidence
outputs: actual verified research findings, methods and source packet

steps.what: Assemble research publication structure, figures and verified references
inputs: actual verified research findings, methods and source packet
outputs: sourced publication structure, figures and references

steps.what: Write publication prose from actual architectural research findings and sources
inputs: sourced publication structure, figures and references
actual verified research findings, methods and source packet

loop.purpose: Draft descriptive research prose from verified architectural evidence
loop.input: teacher-selected findings, methods, limitations and sourced structure
loop.check: Teacher checks interpretation, unsupported design claims, omitted limitations, image permissions and references against actual sources
loop.stop: Absent source, unclear permission or two failed revisions returns section to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native figure/reference layouts serve s2; variable architectural explanations need semantic drafting and checking

steps.what: Complete and check final publication package and retain its exact internal version
inputs: actual verified research findings, methods and source packet
outputs: checked saved final publication package and destination

steps.what: Review final publication and approve its actual specified external submission
inputs: checked saved final publication package and destination
outputs: independently approved publication version and destination

steps.what: Send approved final research publication package to the specified publisher
inputs: independently approved publication version and destination

tasks.design: Keep actual architecture research and verified interpretation human, then configure publication structure and source reuse in {DOCS}. Draft limited prose from that packet with a bounded check, retaining complete final checks, actual independent coauthor review and explicit publisher submission through {PARTNER_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Figures, references and descriptive prose are assembled after research is done.
tasks.enabler_now: Native layouts and source-constrained drafting can reduce preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Architectural interpretation, novel findings and permissions need accountable researchers.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher distinguishes a compelling design explanation from evidence of its actual effect.
tasks.altitude: Less publication preparation; research judgement stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-linked drafting and native publication structure can assist research writing while interpretation and permissions stay human.

assumptions: Provisional multi-author publication route with existing independent coauthor review5, excluded from focal baseline95. No new reviewer is created; actual publisher/editor work is not focal. An actual sole-author or direct electronic publication route must be mapped before applying this scenario.

Researcher supplies real evidence, figure ids/versions, methods, provenance, permissions and verified references in s1; no new observation or citation is generated. Missing evidence requires manual research. Five assembly points and three descriptive typing points disappear after retained checks; ordinary same-system save and external send earn zero saving.
unknowns: What actual publication route and assistance/disclosure rules apply?
research_questions: Can every proposed architectural claim and image be traced to verified evidence and permission?

incremental.description: Maintain publication structures and source/permission checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact final publication package and publisher destination reviewed in s5; edits invalidate approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes5 assembly and3 descriptive prose points:8/95*100 minus1 upkeep=7.421. Low: a book chapter needs new figure layouts and interpretive prose; only2 stable reference/layout points and1 descriptive typing point disappear, giving3/95*100 minus1=2.157. Actual research, final checks, coauthor review and send remain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research.

steps.what: Review actual student teaching, internship or research work and identify supervision needs
Locate current studio, internship and research supervision requirements
Supervise actual work and discuss feedback, difficulties and next actions with students
outputs: actual supervision feedback and agreed next actions

steps.what: Write and check assigned supervision feedback and retain the actual internal progress record
inputs: actual supervision feedback and agreed next actions

tasks.design: Configure current supervision-requirement links in {LMS}/{DOCS}. Keep actual student-work assessment, supervision and complete written feedback/progress records; no grading or ordinary internal saving is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirement versions can require repeated navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native programme links can remove a small part of locating work.
tasks.still_hard: Student work and placement circumstances need individual assessment.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher identifies a research or internship problem that a progress status hides.
tasks.altitude: A small reduction in requirement navigation; supervision stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current programme-source links can reduce locating requirements while student supervision and assessment remain human.

assumptions: Provisional source10 has one repeated locating point removed. Student-work reading and assessment are not reduced. Assigned written feedback is separate and fully retained, including ungated internal save; no transcript or student progress is inferred.

Programme/placement owners supply requirement id, version, study year and applicability; students and actual supervisors supply their work/progress. Missing sources need manual confirmation. Existing links earn no new saving. Actual formal grading or external placement sends must be mapped separately if owned here.
unknowns: Are current supervision requirements already linked?
research_questions: Can current links avoid mixing internship and studio assessment requirements?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes1 requirement-navigation point minus0.2 upkeep=0.8. Low: an unusual external placement needs new manual requirements, leaving only0.3 programme-source locating points removed, minus0.2=0.1. Assessment, supervision and written feedback retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate with colleagues on teaching and research issues.

steps.what: Locate and study actual teaching or research issue papers and prior decisions
inputs: actual course or research papers and decisions

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues on actual teaching and research problems and choices
outputs: actual collaborative decisions, disagreements and actions

steps.what: Write and check assigned collaborative recommendations and actual follow-up actions
inputs: actual collaborative decisions, disagreements and actions
outputs: checked saved actual recommendations and action record

tasks.design: Configure current course/research source links in {DOCS}/{PROJECT}. Reduce repeat navigation while retaining actual collaboration and complete teacher-owned written recommendations and follow-up in the shared workspace.
tasks.previous_blocker: Issue discussions can require locating scattered prior decisions.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can expose the actual current material.
tasks.still_hard: Conflicting teaching and research priorities need collegial judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher helps colleagues choose a workable studio or research response.
tasks.altitude: Less source navigation; collaboration and decisions stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: current shared-source links can reduce locating prior teaching/research decisions while collaboration remains human.

assumptions: Provisional source20 includes two repeated locating points removed, with substantive study retained. Written recommendations20 are split from discussion and unchanged, including ordinary ungated save. No new report, transcript or duplicate send is invented.

Course/research owners supply actual source id, version, issue and adopted/proposed status. Missing context is clarified manually. Decisions and actions arise only from actual collaboration; colleague labour is outside the focal workflow. Existing links receive no new credit.
unknowns: Who actually owns the written follow-up?
research_questions: Can source links distinguish prior proposals from agreed teaching/research decisions?

incremental.description: Maintain current teaching/research source and decision links.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High removes2 source-navigation points minus0.3 upkeep=1.7. Low: a new research issue has few indexed precedents, leaving only0.5 prior-course decision locating points removed, minus0.3=0.2. Actual study, collaboration and full written follow-up keep their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce selected publication preparation and source navigation while retaining student and research judgement.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable preparation supports teachers who retain academic and student decisions.
